interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to crossing points to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked mid-block or intersection crossings with high-visibility paint to designate pedestrian priority areas.

interventions.title: Waste Management Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement regular municipal waste collection and enforce rules against blocking the public right-of-way with bulky items.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to improve visibility, shorten crossing distances, and prevent parking too close to pedestrian areas.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Level and repair the sidewalk surface to ensure a smooth, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing beacons to the mid-block crossing to increase driver awareness and yielding rates.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high, install a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage and high-visibility markings.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential area, mitigating the risk from limited sightlines.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings and appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer place for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Establish a marked crossing with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a formal path to the park area.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Implement designated off-sidewalk areas for trash bins to ensure the pedestrian clear zone remains unobstructed.

interventions.title: Dedicated Waste Storage
interventions.description: Implement designated off-sidewalk storage areas for waste containers to ensure the full width of the walkway remains clear.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting beneath the tree canopy to ensure the sidewalk and crossing areas are well-illuminated at night.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk with Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Formalized Park Entrance Path
interventions.description: Create a paved, accessible path connecting the street edge to the park interior to eliminate the sidewalk gap on the far side.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and appropriate signage to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: If space permits between tracks, a small refuge island could provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing the wide street.

interventions.title: Remove temporary obstructions
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk is kept clear of hoses, cables, or other temporary equipment that creates trip hazards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Designate a specific zone for utility poles and street furniture separate from the clear walking path to maintain accessibility and safety.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Upgrade the painted bike lane to a physically protected lane to better separate cyclists from motor vehicles and tram tracks.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Management
interventions.description: Clear overgrown vegetation and provide designated areas for trash bin storage to maintain a clear walking path.
